<template id="messagePaneTemplate" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <xul:browser id="webBrowser"
               type="content"
               manualactiveness="true"
               hidden="hidden"
               nodefaultsrc="nodefaultsrc"
               context="browserContext"
               autocompletepopup="PopupAutoComplete"
               forcemessagemanager="forcemessagemanager"
               messagemanagergroup="single-page"
               maychangeremoteness="true" />

               hidden="hidden"
               src="about:message" />

               type="content"
               hidden="hidden"
               context="aboutPagesContext"
               src="chrome://messenger/content/multimessageview.xhtml" />
